ChevalGrandSlay:EndlessStaminaPotion.NAME: Endless Stamina Potion
DESCRIPTIONS: This turn, playing Stamina cards does not consume Stamina.

ChevalGrandSlay:PotentialPotion.NAME: Potential Potion
